Dear {{ object.reporter_name or 'Reporter' }},

Thank you for submitting an incident report. Your reference number is {{ object.name }}.

Our team will review your report and may contact you if we need further information.

What happens next:

  • A trained handler will review your report within 3 working days.
  • Where an investigation is required, you will be kept informed of progress.
  • You will receive feedback when the incident is closed.

Thank you for helping us improve safety.
NHS Incident: Closure Feedback to Reporter
Update on Your Incident Report — {{ object.name }}

Dear {{ object.reporter_name or 'Reporter' }},

We are writing to let you know that your incident report {{ object.name }} has now been closed.

We would like to thank you for bringing this to our attention. Your report helps us improve safety for everyone.

If you have any questions, please contact the Quality & Safety team.
NHS Incident: Rejection Feedback to Reporter
Update on Your Incident Report — {{ object.name }}

Dear {{ object.reporter_name or 'Reporter' }},

Thank you for submitting incident report {{ object.name }}.

After review, our team has determined that this report does not meet the criteria for a formal incident record for the following reason:

{{ object.rejection_reason }}

If you believe this decision is incorrect, please contact the Quality & Safety team.
Duty of Candour Deadline Approaching — {{ object.incident_id.name }}

This is a reminder that the Duty of Candour written notification deadline for incident {{ object.incident_id.name }} is on {{ object.written_deadline }}.

Please ensure the written notification is completed and documented before the deadline.

Dear {{ object.owner_id.name }},

The following action is now overdue:

  • Reference: {{ object.reference }}
  • Title: {{ object.name }}
  • Due Date: {{ object.due_date }}

Please update the action record with your progress or request an extension from the Quality & Safety team.
